title: the host check knows the tier (card 10G-11)

findings.claim: on Windows with WSL2 the disk is judged by deploy/windows/wsl2_policy.py (BitLocker's protectors), which does not read the tier: a desk-side Windows box with a TPM-only BitLocker protector is not given the desk-side rule of D-1342

no tier record states desk_side false, and deploy/install.sh labels a no-GPU install P-GB10 (no record): the server-room box of review 16 section 2.8 reads as unknown and takes the stricter rule until it has a record
review 16 section 2.8 asks the DGX Spark for TPM and PIN with no unattended unlock; check_host.sh takes the Spark as unknown (desk-side), which refuses TPM alone but passes a Tang binding
the desk-side rule was run only against the fake host of the tests (TB_HOST_ROOT, stub cryptsetup and clevis); no box with a real LUKS volume and TPM was used
